SSS61.name: 残响龙鱼
SSS61.form: a narrow elongated skull with a crest of ribbed plates, a long tapered snout, a pair of thin whisker-like barbels, layered plates along the underside
SSS61.fins: a long trailing dorsal fin, fan-like pectoral fins, a whip-like tail fin
SSS61.markings: echoing wave bands repeating along the flank

SSS62.name: 空之翼鳐
SSS62.form: a wide flat diamond disc with thin translucent wing margins, a small pointed snout, a long thread-like tail with a single spine
SSS62.fins: broad wing-like pectoral fins swept back, a small slender dorsal fin
SSS62.markings: sparse scattered points on the disc, a hollow oval void on the back

SSS63.name: 时光巨口鲨
SSS63.form: a bulky body with a huge gaping mouth, an oversized blunt head, rows of tiny teeth, overlapping ring plates on the flank
SSS63.fins: a rounded dorsal fin, broad pectoral fins, a crescent tail fin
SSS63.markings: soft ring bands along the flank, a single line of dots behind the gill slits

SSS64.name: 时痕鲽
SSS64.form: a flattened oval body, both eyes on the upper side, a small curved mouth, a thin fringed fin margin
SSS64.fins: a long dorsal fin along the upper edge, an anal fin along the lower edge, a rounded tail fin
SSS64.markings: a mosaic of patches with worn edges, a single scratch-like line behind the eye

SSS65.name: 逆光鳕
SSS65.form: an elongated body with a slightly arched back, a moderate head, a small chin barbel, a clear lateral line
SSS65.fins: three dorsal fins, two anal fins, a slightly forked tail fin
SSS65.markings: a row of luminous pores along the lateral line, a faint rim behind the gill cover

SSS66.name: 纪年鲹
SSS66.form: a streamlined spindle body with a keeled belly, a small head, a terminal mouth, small scales
SSS66.fins: a long low dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, a row of finlets behind the fins
SSS66.markings: stacked year-ring arcs along the flank, a single dot near the tail base

SSS67.name: 溯时鲻
SSS67.form: an elongated rounded body, a broad flattened head, a small terminal mouth, a short caudal peduncle
SSS67.fins: two separate dorsal fins, a forked tail fin, long pectoral fins
SSS67.markings: faint longitudinal lines along the flank, a single ring behind the eye

SSS68.name: 残页鲷
SSS68.form: a deep oval body with a steep forehead, a small mouth, a large eye, a narrow caudal peduncle
SSS68.fins: a long dorsal fin with a spiny front, a rounded tail fin, long pectoral fins
SSS68.markings: irregular angular patches like torn edges, a single band near the tail base

SSS69.name: 空页鲈
SSS69.form: a moderately elongated body with a slightly concave forehead, a large mouth, a short snout, a gently curved lateral line
SSS69.fins: a dorsal fin with a deep notch, a slightly forked tail fin, small pectoral fins
SSS69.markings: a broad blank area on the flank with faint edge lines, a single dot behind the eye

SSS70.name: 遗忘鲳
SSS70.form: a deep oval body with a keeled belly, a small blunt head, a small mouth, a short caudal peduncle
SSS70.fins: a long low dorsal fin, a matching anal fin, a deeply forked tail fin
SSS70.markings: faint fading bands along the flank, a dissolving patch behind the gill cover
